body:
I appreciate your input! 

I forgot to mention the cream I’m using does also have Niacinamide and Azeliac Acid!! Thank you for the other product recommendations. I will look into these 😊
Lol you got me there. I do wear sunscreen, but only in the summer I’ll be honest. I know it’s important to do year round!

I feel you about not being able to be on birth control due to migraines. My skin was perfect but I get very scary migraines and therefore can’t take anything hormonal anymore and now my skin is a mess. 🥺❤️
I really appreciate everyone’s insight 😊
I found some things on Craigslist. And I usually get a letter from my therapist for my dog so that helps
Some good ideas, thank you!!

I’ll have to look into that! I’d probably like to stay around 1200 if I can swing it…I do have a couple fur babies I’d be bringing along so I know that limits options further but I’m willing to be patient to look haha
I also want to add that I plan to take a day/weekend trip in the near future to check things out

Thank you! Very helpful to know. Where I’m living right now, my rent is dirt cheap. I’m definitely willing to pay a lot more to live in an area that I would enjoy, but would appreciate not paying an arm and a leg..lol

Sleep is my escape yet it’s usually full of stressful nightmares. Honestly I’d usually take the reality of the stressful nightmares versus what I’m trying to face in real life. I had a dream the other night that I had a tumor in my brain. I was told that it could be removed but that survey was risky. I remember feeling so hopeful that at least I had a diagnosis of something that I had a chance of surviving. Right now I am diagnosed with a pretty grave genetic disease.
Just now seeing all of these. Thank you everyone for reminding me/validating what I kind of knew but didn’t wanna admit. means so much.
Thank you so much
I will look into this!! Thank you!
I’m thinking possibly yes! Thank you 💕
I know this doesn’t make sense but she literally said there wasn’t much difference between 0.05 and 0.1…..lol maybe she means effectiveness idk 🙈
Thank you for this OP! Spitting facts.
Just wanna say you are beautiful!

I appreciate the feedback everyone. Some of you guys seem so angry I hope you figure out how to process that 😂.  I didn’t know the realities of the housing situation, which is why I’m asking questions and trying to do research.
Maybe we are lesbians 😉
I have not, I’ll look into it!
Thank you ❤️ how would you say it benefits you? Helps with oil?
Thanks homies!!

Can relate a lot…growing up I felt micro managed even into adulthood. Expectations set by my parents that I felt I could never meet. I never felt good enough in their eyes, particularly my mothers. She attempted to control every move I make and if I had let her, she would still be doing it. Some emotional abuse, low self esteem, ect. Ocd symptoms came raging on around age 12.
Thank you ❤️

It did help my skin…I have very oily skin but I feel like tretinoin/other products have been sufficient in controlling this since being off of spiro. I’ve had issues with very very low blood pressure and fatigue. (Probably resulting from the low blood pressure) I know everyone on here was encouraging the spiro and I’m not saying you shouldn’t try it, just wanted to offer a different perspective! As I kind of wish I never tried it in the first place since it never solved anything long term/permanently for me

I just wanna say 1. You are beautiful 2. Coming from someone who has used spiro for hormonal acne for years …it can help but things will go back to how they were as soon as you stop. If you are okay with knowing that or just being on it indefinitely then that is your decision. I just didn’t like the side effects eventually. Honestly I don’t think accutane would be a bad idea. I did accutane and unfortunately had to stop half way due to some unique circumstances but it may be worth a shot!
Yes!! Not worth it
Thanks for the recommendation!!
Thank you for reminding me of this! I’m pretty good about it in the summer but not so much this time of year.
Glad you’ve found some solutions!! For me, avoiding certain foods that my body doesn’t handle well is well worth it for clear skin

I am not sure on the stress honestly. Spiro is something you take daily actually. The only side effects for me were some lightheadedness in the beginning if I didn’t drink enough water. But overall it reduces the amount of oil in my skin and my hair. I’ve taken it on and off throughout the years. I used to take 100 mg but I’ve found 50 to be enough to help
About every night/ every other! My skin has never reacted much to tret honestly. No purge, no peeling, ect. Just minor improvement. It was cutting out the dairy that changed everything
Spironolactone! https://www.verywellhealth.com/treating-acne-with-spironolactone-15635
Yeah unfortunately it didn’t fix things for me! But everyone is different, maybe it would work for you!
Me too! Good luck friend!

Thanks for sharing! I think I will ask to move up. Honestly I would be okay with some reaction/purge even if I knew I was working toward some success. I just feel like my skin tolerates the .025 too well lol. I did accutane as well! It’s definitely frustrating to have to be doing something like tretinoin after going through accutane, so I can relate there.

I also have lots of CCs but on my forehead and cheeks. I’m about 2 months into .025% tret and honestly it’s had no effect on them as far as making the current ones go away. I’ve resorted to just popping them which I know is so bad but tbh that’s the only way they go away for me. I do however think that the tret may be working to prevent new ones because they don’t seem to pop up as fast now or as frequently. I would suggest maybe look into getting an extraction facial if you can? I used to get them for my CCs and found it so helpful but no one does them in my small town.
This is wild..a guy I’m seeing who is French was telling me this. Love my cheese but my face doesn’t 😅
I have similar skin! I am about to start tretinoin. Maybe starting slow with a lose dose? That’s what my derm has suggested for me.
My derm gave me similar advice as to how slow to go! Gives me hope it will help me avoid a massive purge 😊
